مُصَهَّبٌ (tropical:) Flesh-meat mixed with fat. (A, TA.) ―
-b2- (assumed tropical:) What is termed صَفِيف [here app. meaning cut into strips or slices, and laid upon live coals, or upon rocky ground vehemently heated by the sun (see صَيْهَبٌ)], (O, K, and so in a copy of the S, in some copies of the K غَلِيظ, and in one copy ضَعِيف,) of roast flesh-meat. (S, O, K.) ―
-b3- And Wild animals (وَحْش) [of various kinds or species] mixed together. (O, K, and in one of my copies of the S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
